evidence_boundaries: No mask task outcome is reported; every mask task-outcome cell reads 'not measured'.
The engineering pilot is described as a launch event only; it is unknown whether any pilot case finished.
The T3 fidelity result is reported with its failing check (3 px outside the 1-px band in 1 of 117 masks) and all_passed=false.
Policy-input audit numbers (45 camera states) were aggregated by the paper task from the per-camera records in the T3 JSON.
Masks use simulator geometry (oracle-assisted presentation study).
The completed regions study is the only task-outcome evidence and found no benefit.
The pilot launch timestamp and shutdown cause come from the workflow task statement only; no local launch record exists, so the paper states them approximately and as believed.

G1 is covered by the manifest-freeze source verification and its local reproduction, not by a retrieved pilot-time record; G6, G7, G9 and the per-case memory part of G8 have no record; G10 as declared was not met.
